# Szenos Games - Official Information & Press Overview

## Flagship Game: RGB Switcher: Color Roguelike

### Quick Facts
- **Title**: RGB Switcher: Color Roguelike
- **Developer & Publisher**: Szenos Games
- **Release Date**: August 27, 2026
- **Platforms**: iOS (iPhone & iPad)
- **Genre**: Fast-Paced Grid-Based Action Roguelike / Color-Mixing Arcade
- **App Store URL**: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/rgb-switcher-color-roguelike/id6790524090
- **App Store ID**: 6790524090
- **60-Second Gameplay Trailer (YouTube)**: https://youtu.be/teonaXSEr-Q
- **Official Press Kit Page**: https://szenosgames.com/presskit.html
- **Google Drive Press Kit Assets (Screenshots, Logos, Mockups)**: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Jrb5KwbBO9Cy42adNqpJYrHQDdegfyfm?usp=sharing
- **Deep Dive Article**: https://szenosgames.com/rgb-switcher-article.html

### Synopsis & Story
Swipe to survive in a dying black-and-white world. After a civil war between those who loved color and the "Color Haters," all vibrancy was erased into a bleak void. As a Painter, you must master three vital switches—Red, Green, and Blue (RGB)—to mix colors (such as Yellow, Cyan, Magenta, and White), restore corrupted tiles to their original hues, and battle Color-Hater Goblins and their twisted creations.

### Core Gameplay & Features
- **Grid-Based Arcade Action**: Fast-paced swipe movement combined with real-time RGB switch toggling.
- **Color-Repair Mechanics**: Blend Red, Green, and Blue switches on the fly to match and restore corrupted tiles.
- **Roguelike Build Variety**: Unlock and combine Passive and Active abilities every run, such as *Spirit Buddy* (automation), *D.U.C.K* (shielding), and *Mystic Mustangs* (instant row-clearing).
- **Adaptive Procedural Runs**: Driven by an intelligent Adaptive System with procedurally generated maps, randomized ability pools, and unpredictable Level Modifiers.
- **Distinct Enemy Roster**: Battle specialized hazards and monsters including the tile-devouring *Color Mower*, explosive *Boom Moss*, falling *Dripstones*, arrow-slinging *Bowblins*, and the erratic *Crocolor*.
- **Character Customization & High-Contrast Art Style**: Unlockable cosmetics and readable, abstract visual design.
